literal.prompt: В брошюре USGS «Topographic Map Symbols» каким цветом показана растительность среди площадных объектов карты?

sourceReasons: Page 1 Reading Topographic Maps gives vegetation green among area features. Blue denotes water/hydrographic classes, brown topographic contours, black the listed roads/railroads/boundaries/cultural classes. Page 4 visually confirms green vegetation examples. The explicitly named brochure provides a unique intended color under its introductory classification.
fieldGroups.editorialReason: The four options are independent nominal color captions, permitted by the guide; all explicitly state a color and are plausible cartographic alternatives. Reading the prompt with each caption leaves no grammatical clue from case, number or gender. USGS limits the convention to its brochure. Easy asks familiar vegetation/green mapping, not a rare publication detail. The fact belongs to maps-cartography scope: map symbols.

fieldGroups.literal: USGS относит растительность к площадным объектам карты и показывает её зелёным. Это правило относится к системе условных обозначений в этой брошюре о топографических картах, а не ко всем картам без исключения.
sourceReasons: Page 1 lists vegetation green as an area-feature example; the explanation expressly restricts the statement to this brochure on topographic maps. It does not assert a universal rule for every map or every vegetation symbol.
fieldGroups.editorialReason: Two sentences, concise and under 70 words; names the key and its scope. Unchanged exact literal/hash from initial PASS group, personally reread as requested.

fieldGroups.literal: В легенде USGS зелёными знаками показаны лесные массивы, кустарники, сады и виноградники.
sourceReasons: Page 4 VEGETATION has rows Woodland, Shrubland, Orchard and Vineyard. The rendered legend shows pale green area fill or green symbol patterns for all four. «лесные массивы», «кустарники», «сады» and «виноградники» name these four vegetation classes. Mangrove has a blue water pattern and is not included in this note: the text does not claim every vegetation mark is green.
fieldGroups.editorialReason: This now supplies four concrete vegetation categories shown in the legend; none is stated in prompt/key. The additional-fact requirement is met. The fact is about this correct color option, within USGS scope, rather than a repeated color/classification tautology. Neutral, grammatical Russian; 12 words, below 35.

fieldGroups.literal: Синим в брошюре обозначены водные объекты, включая озёра и ручьи.
sourceReasons: Page 1 names lakes and streams in the blue hydrographic class. Page 3 contains stream/river symbols; page 4 contains lake/pond symbols. The note states these examples in the brochure and does not assert every dry lake or every engineered water structure is blue.
fieldGroups.editorialReason: Useful checked fact about the blue distractor. No property is incorrectly assigned from the vegetation key. Unchanged literal/hash, personally reread.

fieldGroups.literal: Горизонтали в брошюре показаны коричневыми линиями; каждая соединяет точки одинаковой высоты.
sourceReasons: Page 1 defines topographic contours as brown and each as equal elevation. Page 2 separates topographic from bathymetric contours; the latter blue/black exception is not confused with topographic горизонтали here.
fieldGroups.editorialReason: Concrete independent fact about the brown-line option: equal-elevation geometry. Clear Russian and below 35 words; unchanged literal/hash, personally reread.

fieldGroups.literal: Чёрным обычно показаны другие дороги и тропы, железные дороги, границы и другие культурные объекты.
sourceReasons: Page 1 lists other roads/trails, railroads, boundaries and cultural features usually black, contrasted with important roads red. Page 4 road legend and page 3 railroad section retain the distinction. The qualifier «обычно» does not claim all roads or all cultural symbols are black.
fieldGroups.editorialReason: A specific fact about the black-sign option. Scope inherited from the expressly named brochure; neutral language and below 35 words. Unchanged literal/hash, personally reread.
